name: element.at
description: Hit-test: return the UI Automation element at the given screen coordinates. Returns `ERR not_found` if no element is hit (rare — usually the desktop or a chrome-less window).

automation_id.description: UIA AutomationId. Empty string when the element doesn't expose one.

flags.description: Universally-determinable UIA boolean states currently true on the element. Per issue #92.

x-implementations.name: uia_element_from_point
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomation::ElementFromPoint`. Allocates a fresh `elt:N` id for the returned element.

x-implementations.name: msaa_iaccessible
x-implementations.description: MSAA `AccessibleObjectFromPoint` at the requested screen point. The window under the point is pinged first (`SendMessageTimeout(WM_NULL, SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG)`) so a hung target gives `ERR target_gone` instead of blocking.

windows-modern.description: ElementFromPoint at the requested screen coordinate. UIPI: hits on higher-IL windows return `ERR uia_blind` rather than the element. Coordinates outside the virtual-screen bounds return `ERR not_found`.

windows-classic.description: AccessibleObjectFromPoint hit-test. A hung window at the point gives `ERR target_gone`. No UIPI on classic, so `uia_blind` is never returned. Shared MSAA rules (roles, tree shape, hidden elements, hung windows, handle limits): PROTOCOL.md §10.7.
